nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Học hành & dự định · bài tự soạn
kind: Tin nhắn thoại về lớp tiếng Anh buổi tối
L: Hey Lan, it's Minh. I finally started my evening English class!
It's twice a week, and the teacher makes us speak the whole time.
At first I was so nervous that I could hardly say a word.
Now I'm getting used to it, and I'm kinda enjoying it.
I want to pass the test in June, so I practice for half an hour every night.
Honestly, watching series without subtitles helps a lot.
Do you wanna study together on weekends? It'd be way more fun.
Text me back when you're free. Talk later!
